## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/ledger.sh:196`: `PHASES` is forward-only. `advance` refuses to go backward (`:466-467`), and `released` is last.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:632`: `record --pr` overwrites `.pr = {url, number}`, dropping `.pr.merge_sha`.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:723-724`: `handoff` refuses an entry past `pr` ("already past pr"). This is the #139.2 symptom.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:484-495`: `released` checks `in_branch <branch> <final>` only when there is more than one environment. This is the #139.3 symptom.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:429-434`: the claim BUSY filter counts owned entries per repo and role and ignores phase. This is the #139.4 symptom.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:603-622`: `run --exit` is the only path that clears an owner (plus `release`, `ledger-notes.sh:83-89`). Reaching `merged` or `released` does not clear it.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:137,481,592,814,848`, `hooks/pr-watch.sh:286`, `hooks/session-launch.sh:530`: every reader of `.pr.*`. No command `.md` reads `.pr`.
- `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:183-192`: an op is born `queued` and has no other state. `claim` refuses ops (`ledger.sh:416`), and `next` skips them (`:852`).
- `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:50-71`: `scope_check` normalises the scope to exactly `{title, steps, heads, stop_checks, not_covered, irreversible, commands}`. An unknown key is dropped.
- `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:143`: `action heads` reads each head with `${HEFESTO_GH_BIN:-gh} pr view -R repo --json headRefOid` and fails closed.
- `hooks/lane-guard.sh:66-80`: `EXCL_HIT` is the first word of a matching `excludedCommands` entry, found anywhere in the command, quoted or escaped. A user's unsandboxed command is an absolute path (`hefesto-setup.sh:190-192`), so `EXCL_HIT` is that path.
- `hooks/lane-guard.sh:166,174-178`: `try_grant` runs before the gh-write deny, so a granted command is allowed and anything else falls through to the deny. FR-015 adds its rule at the same spot.
- `hooks/lane-lib.sh:46-53`: `is_person_sub` is the one list shared by `caller_gate` (`ledger.sh:228-241`) and lane-guard (`:119`). `unblock`, `op` and `request` are already person-only.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:86-102`: `branches_model` reads only `repo_config`. Every consumer resolves through `ledger.sh branches` (`session-launch.sh:231`, `pr-watch.sh:259`, `speckit-helper.sh:78-81`, `merge-tree-probe.sh:43`), so one change covers US6.
- `hooks/board-lib.sh:48-59`: `board_repos` accepts only `name → string`, and an object value dies today.
- `hooks/ledger-notes.sh:83-89`: `ledger.sh release <id>` already exists (a person releases an interactive claim). US3's subcommand is named `deployed` instead.
- `hooks/release.sh:18-29`: dies outside this repo (requires `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`). US10's check is a new `hooks/changelog-check.sh`.
- `CHANGELOG.md:1808`: a stray, empty `## [Unreleased]` between 3.0.0 and 2.1.0.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- **Sourced parts.** `ledger.sh` dot-sources its parts at `:64-76`: `board-lib.sh` and `ledger-lanes.sh` behind `[ -f ] || die`, while `lane-lib.sh`, `ledger-actions.sh` and `ledger-notes.sh` are unguarded (corrected by the plan review). The new parts get the guard. An arm parses flags into globals and calls one function (`request` `:652-657` → `request_action`). New lifecycle code follows this: `hooks/ledger-lifecycle.sh` and `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh`, plus one or two dispatch lines each.
- **Atomic writes.** `jq '…' <<<"$E" | write_entry "$ID" || exit 1` (`:257-268`): a temp file in `$DIR`, then `mv`. The `|| exit 1` is mandatory because the write runs in a pipeline subshell.
- **History** is arrays appended inline (`.runs += [...]` `:615`, `.verdicts` `:514`, `.answers`/`.revisions` `ledger-lanes.sh:107,119`). There is no generic history field. 9.1 adds `.events += [{kind, at, by, note}]` for reopen, terminal phase, deployed and automatic owner release.
- **Errors.** `die` exits 1 (`:23`), and usage errors exit 2 (`:24-49`). A helper that cannot judge exits 2, never 0 (constitution 5).
- **Two person gates.** `caller_gate` (by the session record's role) and `person_gate` (`ledger-lanes.sh:37-44`: not a worker, `--reviewed-by-human --by`). Both fail open without a lanes session record, where the permission dialog of the ask rule is the gate.
- **Trust for unsandboxed commands.** They come only from setup's command line, are written to `settings.local.json` (`sandbox.excludedCommands` plus `env.HEFESTO_SETUP_EXTRA.user_excl`), and are copied into the session record at SessionStart (`session-start-context.sh:114`). Lane-guard reads the record, under `~/.cache/hefesto/sessions`, which the Edit deny protects (`hefesto-setup.sh:161-162`).
- **Tests.** Each section uses a `x_fail` flag, `cond || { bad "…"; x_fail=1; }`, one `ok` summary, and FR ids in comments (`# lanes-interactive FR-003..012`, `:5506`). Fixtures use a throwaway `HOME`, `sld()` and a fake gh via `HEFESTO_GH_BIN`.

## Resolved during research (were spec decisions)
- **US3 is named `deployed`, not `release`:** the name is taken (`ledger-notes.sh:83-89`). The spec is updated.
- **A merge action's `done` records the merge** through `merge_evidence`, because `unblock` is person-only (`lane-lib.sh:46-53`). The spec is updated (FR-021).
- **The placement check lives in `hooks/changelog-check.sh`,** because `release.sh` dies outside this repo (`release.sh:25-27`). The spec is updated.
- **The eval seam covers two cases:** `board-text-is-data` writes sandbox-only settings and no env (`scaffold.sh:24`). The spec is updated.
- **New smoke checks go in a sourced part,** `tests/smoke-lifecycle.sh`, run from `smoke.sh`. `smoke.sh` is over the limit and sources nothing today.

## Open Questions
- The exact `prompt.md` + `graders/*.md` format for `claude plugin eval`. The README names it (`evals/README.md:34`), but no case in this repo uses it. The plan converts one case first and runs it before converting the second.
- Whether the eval harness passes a `prompt.md` `env:` value to hooks and Bash commands, not only to the model's process. This will be verified with the same throwaway probe that showed the settings env is ignored (2026-10-26).
